mapper.select: SELECT id AS linkId, domain_id AS domainId, created_by_user_id AS createdByUserId FROM t_link WHERE id = #{linkId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE t_link SET full_url = #{fullUrl}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{linkId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: WITH target AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT status, disabled_reason_code FROM t_link WHERE id = #{linkId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ), changed AS ( UPDATE t_link SET status = CASE WHEN #{enabled} THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'DISABLED' END, disabled_reason_code = CASE WHEN #{enabled} THEN NULL ELSE 'MANUAL' END, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{linkId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND ( (#{enabled} AND status = 'DISABLED' AND disabled_reason_code = 'MANUAL') OR (NOT #{enabled} AND status = 'ACTIVE') ) RETURNING id ) SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM target) THEN 0 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM changed) THEN 3 WHEN #{enabled} AND (SELECT status FROM target) = 'DISABLED' AND (SELECT disabled_reason_code FROM target) != 'MANUAL' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
mapper.update: UPDATE t_link SET deleted_at = now(), revision = revision + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{linkId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
